properties.name: ❌ Beehive Trail Acadia National Park ME
properties.description: A 1.4-mile loop that ascends the sheer southeastern face of the Beehive via iron rungs and ladder-like iron bars bolted into the granite — essentially a via ferrata without equipment. Returns via the Bowl, a glacial pond on the summit plateau.

Often closed in spring for peregrine falcon nesting; check status before going."

properties.name: Woodland Heritage Scenic Byway
properties.description: A 72-mile New Hampshire scenic byway through the North Country and Great North Woods — Lancaster, Northumberland/Groveton, Stark, Milan, Berlin, and Gorham, following the Connecticut, Upper Ammonoosuc, and Androscoggin rivers past working mill towns, remote peaks, and the Devil's Slide cliff.
